## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Evidence

Include tests, screenshots, logs, or a replay result that verifies the change.

## Safety and data review

- [ ] No secrets or personal information are included.
- [ ] New data or dependency edges include provenance and confidence.
- [ ] LLM-generated text cannot modify calculated facts.
- [ ] Failure and stale-data behavior is documented.

## Completion checklist

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] PROJECT_STATUS is accurate
- [ ] The change is scoped to the MVP or has a documented reason
